description: SharePoint list-item capture through the GET-only Graph client over the shipped scope (integrations/sharepoint_list_capture_scope.json: the Vendor Quotes list the Portal's RFQ form writes, plx-customer-portal@31a2623 portal/src/app/api/rfq/submit/route.ts:5,176; docs/decisions/2026-10-10-gen-graph-residual-list-items.md option b): the list read first (it must be that list and not a document library), then its items with the scope's columns only, page by page through server nextLinks, and each item's own permissions as the audience of its version (the v1.0 item read; once v1.0 refuses it, the documented beta /beta/sites/{id}/lists/{id}/items/{id}/permissions read of each item for the rest of the list's run, counted as acl_read_beta and named in operations_read; never a list- or site-wide ACL; the first beta 403 or 404 stops permission reads for the whole list), into the check's temporary Workbench state (outside the git tree). Run 2 reads the list again (unchanged items add no version). Then the store is read back offline as a reader the item permissions grant (what it sees resolves), as an outsider granted the list but named by no item's permissions (sees 0) and as a withheld principal (sees 0). Graph application permission needed: Sites.Read.All. A 401/403 from Graph is reported as blocked_upstream with error_code missing_permission (403) and the permission the refused read needs, part sharepoint_list.list, sharepoint_list.items or sharepoint_list.item_permissions, never as a pass. Counts, booleans and enums only.
notes: Live-unverified: written and checked against the injected-transport fixture run only (integrations/tests/test_capture_sharepoint_lists.py, ProbeTests runs this argv over a fake Graph; evidence label injected-transport). Unverified live assumptions: the application's Sites.Read.All grant reads the personal (petrasoap-my) site the list lives on; the Portal's fallback site and list ids are the ones production writes (RFQ_SHAREPOINT_SITE_ID / RFQ_VENDOR_QUOTES_LIST_ID may name another list on Vercel); Graph v1.0 or, after v1.0 refuses it (listItem permissions are not in the pinned v1.0 metadata), the documented beta per-item read answers listItem permissions app-only (else every item is kept with an unreadable ACL: summary.acl_unreadable counts them, the reader sees 0 and the check fails with reason acl_endpoint_not_found on a beta 404, or reports blocked on a beta 401/403 naming part sharepoint_list.item_permissions); a run that resumed is complete only when every current item's permissions are read, those saved before the resume included; the item permissions name the site owner by the address the example audience gives staff:list-reader; listed items carry parentReference.siteId as the composite site id or its site collection id (else they are dropped, provenance_dropped). summary.items_current >= 1 holds only while the list has a quote. registry_names: the source registry credits a Graph endpoint template only through operations_read, the grammar operations (integrations/live_source_grammar.py) this run's GETs were answered for.
